fighters.name: Plague Monk with Pair of Foetid Blades
Plague Monk with Foetid Blade and Woe-stave
Stormvermin with Rusty Halberd and Clanshield

abilities.name: Befoul the Land
abilities.text: Pick an objective within 3" of this fighter or a treasure token within 3" of this fighter. That treasure token can be one that is being carried by a fighter if that fighter is visible to this fighter. Roll a dice at the end of the battle round for each enemy fighter within 3" of that objective or treasure token. On a roll of 3+, allocate D3 damage points for the fighter being rolled for. The same objective or treasure token cannot be picked more than once per battle round.

abilities.name: Disgusting Appearance
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic (to a minimum of 1) of melee attack actions made by enemy fighters that target this fighter.

abilities.name: Unctuous Citations
abilities.text: Pick a friendly fighter with the Skabbik's Plaguepack runemark that is within 7" of this fighter. This fighter can make a bonus move action or a bonus attack action, and then the fighter you picked can make the same bonus action.

abilities.name: Manifestation of a Great Plague
abilities.text: Pick this fighter, or pick a number of objectives visible to this fighter equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up). Allocate a number of damage points equal to the value of this ability to all enemy fighters within 3" of either this fighter or those objectives.

abilities.name: Consume Warpstone Token
abilities.text: Roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of 1, allocate 1 damage point to this fighter. For each roll of 4+, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit or critical hit from the next missile attack action made by this fighter in this activation.

abilities.name: Crack the Whip
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly fighter with the Beast runemark within 4" of this fighter. That fighter makes a bonus melee attack action.

abilities.name: Flesh-mend
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly fighter with the Beast runemark within 4" of this fighter. Remove a number of damage points allocated to that fighter up to half the value of this ability (rounding up).

abilities.name: Hired Bodyguard
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, friendly fighters with the Hero runemark cannot be targeted while they are within 1" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Scurry Away
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 3" of an enemy fighter. Roll a dice. On a roll of 2+, this fighter makes a bonus disengage action.

abilities.name: Warp Lightning
abilities.text: Pick a number of enemy fighters up to the value of this ability. The first fighter picked must be within 6" of, and visible to, this fighter and each subsequent fighter picked must be within 3" of, and visible to, a fighter that has already been picked. The same fighter cannot be picked more than once. Allocate 1 damage point to each fighter picked.

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, the next time this fighter finishes a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter, pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. Allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Lead From The Back
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by visible friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Poisonous Fumes
abilities.text: Roll a dice for each visible enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter. On a roll of 3+, allocate a number of damage points equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up) to that fighter.

abilities.name: Running Death
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus move action or bonus disengage action. In addition, until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each critical hit from attack actions made by this fighter.

abilities.name: Expend Warpstone Spark Canister
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus attack action. In addition, add half the value of this ability (rounding up) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from that attack action.

abilities.name: Recite from the Book of Woes
abilities.text: Until the end of the battle round, enemy fighters cannot use abilities while they are within 3" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Musk of Fear
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after an enemy fighter finishes a move action visible to this fighter and within 3" of this fighter. Pick another friendly fighter with the Skaven faction runemark within 3" of this fighter. That fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus disengage action, and must end that action more than 3" away from the enemy fighter that made the move action.

abilities.name: There are Always More
abilities.text: At the end of the battle rounds 2 and 3, you can pick a friendly fighter with this battle trait that is taken down and has a points cost of 70 or less. At the start of the next battle round, you can place that fighter on a platform or on the battlefield floor, more than 6" from each enemy fighter, objective and treasure token, and within 3" of one or more battlefield edges.

abilities.name: Way of the Slinking Rat
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 3" of an enemy fighter. Roll a dice. On a roll of 2+, this fighter can make a bonus disengage action.

abilities.name: Spitting Cobra Technique
abilities.text: Pick an enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll that equals or exceeds that enemy fighter's Toughness characteristic, allocate 3 damage points to that enemy fighter.

abilities.name: Way of the Hidden Paw
abilities.text: This fighter can make a bonus move action. Then this fighter can make a bonus attack action. Add X to the Attacks characteristic of that bonus attack action, where X is the number of friendly fighters with the Skittershank's Clawpack runemark within 1" of the target.

abilities.name: There Are Always More
abilities.text: Pick a friendly fighter with both the Spiteclaw's Swarm and the Minion runemark that has been taken down.  Set up that fighter once more on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this fighter.  The fighter set up on the battlefield no longer counts as being taken down.  Remove a number of damage points allocated to that fighter up to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Unleashed Warp-fury
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus attack action. At the end of this fighter's activation, allocate a number of damage points to this fighter equal to the number of damage points allocated to this fighter.

abilities.name: Forward, Minions!
abilities.text: Pick a visible friendly fighter with the Skaven runemark and that does not have the Hero or Monster runemark wholly within 6" of this fighter. That fighter can make a bonus attack action and a bonus move action up to a number of inches equal to the value of this ability. If an enemy fighter is not taken down by damage points allocated by that attack action, or if that move action does not end within 1" of an enemy fighter, allocate D6 damage points to that friendly fighter.

abilities.name: Warpstone Sights
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 18" of this fighter. For the rest of this fighter's activation, subtract the value of this ability from the Toughness characteristic of that enemy fighter (to a minimum of 1). If this fighter has not moved this activation and the value of this ability is equal to or greater than the unmodified Toughness characteristic of that enemy fighter, count each hit scored from the next missile attack action made by this fighter as a critical hit instead. Before the Total Damage step for each of this fighter's missile attack actions this activation, this fighter makes a bonus move action up to a number of inches equal to half the value of this ability, directly away from the target of that ranged attack and as if they were jumping.

abilities.name: Tunnel-skitter
abilities.text: Pick a point on the battlefield floor or a platform within 9" of this fighter. Then, remove this fighter from the battlefield and set them up within 1" of that point and more than 5" from all enemy fighters.

abilities.name: Tick Tick Tick...
abilities.text: If your Tik Tik is taken down and is listed on your warband roster, set up a friendly Tik Tik within 1" of this fighter. That Tik Tik cannot move this turn.

abilities.name: Kaboom!
abilities.text: Allocate D3 damage points to each enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter and gain 1 wild dice. Then, remove this fighter from the battlefield (this fighter is taken down).

abilities.name: Vrrrrrmmmmmm!
abilities.text: If this fighter is within 3" of the battlefield edge, remove this fighter from the battlefield, then roll a dice. Then, set them up on the battlefield floor, within 3" of the battlefield edge and more than X" from all enemy fighters, where X is equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Drill-drill the Fool-Foe!
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll 6 dice. For each roll that is equal to or less than the value of this ability, allocate 1 damage point to that enemy fighter, subtract 1 from the value of this ability and roll those dice again. Keep rolling in this way until the value of this ability is 0 or none of the dice rolled are equal to or less than the value of this ability.
